verdict.rationale: Jeeves offers API/MCP capabilities to query transactions, cards, and vendors and even initiate vendor payments or card actions in one interface (jeeves-docs-10, 14, 34, 47), which loosely maps to searching across these entities and acting on them, but there is no evidence of an actual UI-level 'universal search bar' that lets a finance-lead search across transactions/vendors/cards and jump into payment initiation from one search box. missing for 10: a documented unified search-bar UI feature, evidence it spans all three entity types simultaneously, and confirmation it lets the user directly launch a payment from search results.
